svg.text: Entity forms in the Replay Browser — read-only (house style; DESIGN_Details_Forms.md §2.4, R-4148)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
A · The Replay Browser's Details panel — the SAME forms, read-only
Grey says it: no banner, no tooltip (R-4150) — the Recording chip, the time axis and
the main bar's clock already say where and when. No Apply / Revert / Undo, no pickers.
'not recorded': the row's source is not in this recording (DataPolicy) —
never a blank or a default that looks like a value.
B · Seek — the values follow the playhead
After a seek, each row whose value changed is tinted for ~1 s and shows
the clock glyph (Q-R1) — the eye finds what the jump changed.
During normal play nothing flashes: values just update (0 B per frame).
C · The Brain tab's Character, and copying a value
Move to OBJ Bridge · step 2 of 4
Right-click a row: Copy value / Copy the whole form (text, for a report) — the only
actions in read-only (Q-R3). Edit is listed greyed with its reason, like every menu (R-4132).
Editable = ONE function of (run state, edit mode, authority): Replay ⇒ read-only, the same as the editor's Review mode.
The chip names the reason: Edit mode (green) · Live (amber) · Review (blue) · Recording (violet). The form has no 'if replay'.
